conviction_note: Event confirmed for 2026-10-14 at 15:30 JST (window: 10-14 close to 10-15 close). The domestic FC wholesale 月次 show Q2 (Jun-Aug) flat year on year (all-store 97.3/94.2/108.8) after +10.1% in Q1, so Q2 operating profit likely lands near last year's 2,408m. That is below the stale July IFIS Q2 consensus of 2,600m but leaves H1 OP near 5,100m, which is 50% of the unrevised 10,200m plan. Komeda does not revise mid-year: it missed its FY26 pretax plan by 6.4% without cutting it. Its last five prints all fell 1.5-2.5% the next day, a Q1 beat among them, and the margin long is crowded (信用倍率 8.61). Those set a mild negative lean, p_up 44 on abs 2.3. The findings sum to -0.4. Both numbers are small and agree in sign. The main negative rests on public 月次, so it is mostly priced.
bar: IFIS consensus via Monex scouter (2026-07-14 snapshot): Q2 revenue 15,738m, Q2 OP 2,600m, H1 OP 5,100m. FY27 consensus pretax 10,152m against a company plan of 10,160m, so consensus sits on the plan (kabuyoho, IFIS, current). There is no company H1 guide. Sources: https://scouter.monex.co.jp/news/detail/3543_20260715_act_20260715_153048_10 , https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportTop?bcode=3543 . The Q2 consensus predates the July and August 月次 and may since have been marked down, so the bar is partly stale.
positioning_check: JPX short register as of 2026-09-29: 0.0%, with no disclosed position at or above 0.5% and no change (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, from the baseline). 信用倍率 8.61x per kabutan 2026-10-14 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3543): margin longs are crowded, the one setup in which a visible miss still has sellers. There is no option skew. The baseline priced_lean is -0.37, driven by margin overhang. 20-day run-up -2.04%, 5-day -0.29%.

findings.finding: Komeda's own 月次 show domestic FC wholesale sales of 97.3% (Jun), 94.2% (Jul) and 108.8% (Aug) year on year, about 100% for Q2 against 110.1% in Q1, on the Pokemon-campaign comp. Q2 domestic wholesale revenue is therefore about 10.18bn against 10.17bn last year (last year's H1 19,452m less Q1 9,281m). Q2 revenue comes to about 15.5bn against a 15.74bn consensus, and Q2 OP to roughly 2.3-2.55bn against 2.6bn consensus and 2.41bn last year. H1 OP lands near 5.0-5.2bn, about 50% of the 10.2bn plan.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: At last year's H1 (2025-10-08, 15:30), H1 OP progress came in under 50% and the stock fell 1.48% the next day (kabutan: '営業利益の進捗率５割を下回る'). At Q3 (2026-01-14), OP +4.5% was called '織り込み済み' and the stock fell 2.48%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The 月次 have been public since 2026-07-10, 08-10 and 09-10, and the stock is down from 2,875 before Q1 to 2,789. What may not be priced is the step down in profit growth from +15.5% in Q1 to about flat in Q2, which the July IFIS Q2 consensus of 2,600m did not carry. If the market had fully marked it, the stock would sit flat into the print rather than near its lows with longs crowded at 8.6x. Sized small under rule 1.
findings.independence: Last year's H1 tanshin (https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/35430/140120251008569942.pdf) gives the base, Q2 FY26 domestic wholesale of 10,171m. That is a different document, but the inference rests on the same 月次 series.

findings.finding: Margin tailwind: Q1 FY27 showed '原材料減等による原価率良化' (+65m in the OP bridge), and the FC wholesale price rise that took effect after August 2025 is still in the H1 FY27 year-on-year base. Flat wholesale revenue may therefore carry better gross margin than in Q2 FY26, partly offsetting the volume shortfall.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q1 FY27 OP beat (+4.4% against IFIS on pretax) was sold -1.74% the next day, so margin beats have not been rewarded.
findings.why_not_priced: Translating a flat wholesale line into flat-or-better profit takes the price-and-cost bridge, and the monthly sales series does not show it. A market that had priced it would not have the Q2 headline built off revenue momentum alone.
findings.independence: Last year's H1 tanshin (https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/35430/140120251008569942.pdf) states that FC wholesale prices were held until the end of August 2025. That is a separate document.

findings.finding: Reaction function and positioning: the next-session moves after the last five releases were -2.41, -1.48, -2.48, -2.25 and -1.74 (8 of 11 since 2024 negative). They include a record-profit FY print with a dividend increase and a Q1 consensus beat. The margin long is crowded at 信用倍率 8.61x.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Computed from Yahoo daily closes on the actual release dates (2025-07-11, 2025-10-08, 2026-01-14, 2026-04-08, 2026-07-15, all 15:30 releases): next-day moves -2.41, -1.48, -2.48, -2.25, -1.74.
findings.why_not_priced: This is a pattern, not information, and it agrees with the baseline's margin-overhang lean (-0.47). It is filed because the definition gives the reaction function veto power over the fundamental read: holders in this retail-heavy 優待 register have sold every print for five straight prints.
findings.independence: kabutan 信用倍率 8.61x (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3543) and the 2025-10-09 and 2026-01-15 kabutan articles ('冴えない', '織り込み済み') describe the same selling.

findings.finding: September 月次 published 2026-10-13: domestic FC wholesale all-store 108.4% and existing-store 104.3%, against a 104.1% comp. Volume recovered after the Pokemon comp lapped, so the H2 outlook statement has a clean start.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean history. The stock was -0.61% at 10:03 JST on 10-14, the session after publication.
findings.why_not_priced: It was published the afternoon before the print and has had one session. It supports holding the full-year plan, which management will be asked to defend, but it is largely in the price already.

Returns: interim dividend of 31 yen already guided, with no buyback or 優待 change at prior H1 prints. New-year guide: not applicable (H1). Quarter: H1 OP likely about 49-51% of plan against own history of 49.6% (FY24), 50.5% (FY25) and 49.9% (FY26), so in line. Q2 YoY growth slows sharply from Q1's +15.5%.

baseline_tension: The findings agree with the baseline's mild negative lean (margin overhang) and the slightly negative run-up. The strongest positive the release could carry is a held full-year plan with H1 at or above 50%, helped by cost tailwinds and the September rebound. I looked for buybacks or dividend changes at prior H1 prints and found none, so the lean stays mild.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on public 月次 or 進捗率): finding 1 cut from -0.6 to -0.3 and p_up moved from 40 to 44

Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): the strongest positive (held plan, cost tailwind, September rebound, buyback history) is written into baseline_tension. I had looked, so p_up did not move again
Left standing: finding 3 (reaction function and positioning, not 月次-based), finding 2 and finding 4
